answer: The strongest single control I know for this is typing rhythm on a mobile keyboard, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 779 fakes spends 10127 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One oasis of signal, one grove of cost, one pulse of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
